The '''Idd family''' lived on [[Lonn Idd's repair station]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The most senior, [[Lonn Idd]] ran a droid repair business with the assistance of his children, [[Vik Idd]] and [[Nikki Idd]].
